steps.title: Wind, water and throwing
steps.body: Fans that blow, a leaf that makes a gust, pinwheels the wind turns, rocks and pots to throw at switches, and rivers whose current pushes (as in the wind temples of Zelda and Breath of the Wild’s Korok Leaf). They are under Starter pack › Wind and throwing. The wind pushes things as real air does, by drag: light things blow away, heavy ones stay put.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: A fan
steps.body: Place a Fan 12 studs ahead of the start with its open front toward the start (before you click, press R to turn it until the opening faces you), so it blows back toward the start. Air leaves its front at 16 studs a second and reaches 16 studs, slowing as it goes; a wall stops it.
steps.task: Place a Fan facing the start.

steps.title: Walk into the wind
steps.body: Press Play and walk (W) straight toward the fan. As you come into its wind you slow down: you lean into it, an arm up in front of your face, with short heavy steps; near the fan the wind is strongest. Stop walking and you brace, turned to face it. Jump in it and it carries you back: in the air nothing holds you.
steps.task: Press Play and walk into the fan’s wind.

steps.title: The Gust leaf and a pinwheel
steps.body: Stop the game. Place the Gust leaf just to the side of the start and a Pinwheel a little further off on the same side.
steps.task: Place the Gust leaf and a Pinwheel.

steps.title: Spin the pinwheel
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the Gust leaf: it goes into an item button. Press that button (J) to take it out, walk up to the pinwheel and swing it (F): a gust blows ahead and the pinwheel spins round. It is a switch Turned by the wind: wire it to a gate or a Switch fan with logic.
steps.task: Press Play and swing the Gust leaf at the pinwheel.

steps.title: Blow a flame out
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Burning torch on the other side of the start. A small flame goes out in a strong wind: a lit torch stand, or a burning stick.

steps.title: Swing the leaf at it
steps.body: Press Play, take out the Gust leaf and swing it at the Burning torch: the gust blows its flame out. (Water puts fire out too: a burning stick dipped in water goes out, and a lit bomb that falls in fizzles.)
steps.task: Press Play and blow the torch out.

steps.title: A rock and a crystal switch
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Rock in front of the start a little to the left, and a Crystal switch further on in line with it.
steps.task: Place a Rock and a Crystal switch.

steps.title: Throw it
steps.body: Press Play. Face the rock and press E (Lift): the hero lifts it over its head. Walk toward the crystal switch and press E again: walking, it throws (an arc; the physics engine rolls it to rest). The switch it strikes is hit. Standing still, E puts it down instead: a rock lying on a floor switch holds it down, and a Clay pot breaks where it lands.
steps.task: Press Play and throw the rock at the crystal switch.

steps.title: A river’s current
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a River behind the start (Scene › Water › River: 4.4 deep, its current 3 studs a second; change them in the Inspector). Loose things float down it.

steps.title: Swim in the current
steps.body: Press Play, turn round and walk into the river. It is deep enough to swim in: the current carries you downstream as you swim (swimming against it is slow). Hold E (Dive) to go under, let go to drift back up. Shallow water you wade instead (chest-deep at most), and a strong current there pushes on your legs.
steps.task: Press Play and swim in the river.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You walked into a fan’s wind, spun a pinwheel and blew a torch out with the Gust leaf, threw a rock at a crystal switch, and swam in a river’s current. Make your own in the Asset studio: Wind and lifting › Blows wind (speed, reach, width, height, when) and Lift and throw (breaks, weight); a switch Turned by the wind is a pinwheel.
